description: A ceiling (90 degrees from vertical) outside the roof that would bridge 14 mm, more than the 12 mm maxUnsupportedBridgeMm: blocker on fdm-0.4, which prints without supports.

findings.fix: chamfer the overhang at 50° or less from vertical (maxOverhangDeg), hold it from below, or keep a bridge between two supports within 12 mm; process `fdm-0.4` prints without supports
findings.message: 1 region of downward faces hangs up to 90° from vertical, beyond the 50° maxOverhangDeg of process `fdm-0.4`, without a short bridge (it would bridge 14 mm, more than the 12 mm maxUnsupportedBridgeMm); the steepest is 2 mm above the bed near x 8 mm, y 16 mm in print orientation

unchecked.reason: no printer or bed was given, so the part was not checked against a build volume; choose a printer (openbrick validate --printer, or the playground's printer menu) or give a bed (--bed WxDxH)
